dataset_info.description: Temple University Hospital EEG Artifact Corpus: clinical EEG with channel-wise artifact annotations.
dataset_info.reference: Buckwalter, G., Chhin, S., Rahman, S., Obeid, I., & Picone, J. (2021). Recent advances in the TUH EEG corpus: improving the interrater agreement for artifacts and epileptiform events. IEEE SPMB.
dataset_info.notes: Annotations use the TCP bipolar montage; a window's label here ignores the channel and artifact type.
